name: Otoineppu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Otoineppu village emblem in red and white: a red hexagonal snowflake-like device bearing the character 音 in white.
history: Municipal flag of Otoineppu, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 27 June 1965.

features.role: Otoineppu village emblem — a red hexagonal snowflake-like device bearing the character 音 in white
